validation.windows_browser_checks: Account six-way video requests; warm draft/hash/iframe conversations; independent chats; cancellation; five serial fallback cases; shared conversation; four acknowledgement/clarification cases.
validation.packaged_executable: Actual packaged EXE startup; ten concurrent named images with loopback fetch deliberately failed; persistent saved folders and numbering after restart; ten exact compact TXT names; ten videos in one chat capped at six; explicit concurrency rejection followed by ten successful serial slots.
validation.preserved_features: TXT/SRT names, all imported prompts, download counters, account limits, proxy IPs, sessions and renderer recovery.
